name: Christina Lucero
office: Baldwin Park Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Christina Lucero served on the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education from 2007 until a recent gap, and is running to return to the board. She has served as board president, including a third consecutive term. She is a retired special education advocate and previously served as a state and federal delegate for the California School Boards Association.

sentences.text: Christina Lucero served on the Baldwin Park Unified School District Board of Education from 2007 until a recent gap, and is running to return to the board.
She has served as board president, including a third consecutive term.
She is a retired special education advocate and previously served as a state and federal delegate for the California School Boards Association.

items.text: She identifies fiscal solvency and special education as priorities. In 2016, she supported hiring Froilan Mendoza as superintendent, stating he unified people to provide high-quality education.
